content.text: Oe ka hringnae BAWIPA teh pholen haw.
Ka thung kaawm e pueng
a min kathoung teh pholen awh.
Oe ka hringnae BAWIPA teh pholen nateh
ahawinae pueng hah pahnim hanh.
Na payonnae pueng ka ngaithoumkung,
na patawnae pueng kadamsakkung,
rawk kahmanae koehoi na hringnae
karatangkung hoi ngai kaawm e lungmanae hoi
lungpatawnae bawilakhung na kamuksakkung,
Na nawnae hah mataw patetlah bout katha nahanlah,
na cue toteh hnokahawi hoi na lung a kuep sak.
BAWIPA ni kângingnae hah a kangdue sak teh,
repcoungroenae pueng hanelah,
kângingnae lah a kangdue sak.
A lamthung hah Mosi koe a panue sak teh,
a sak e naw hah Isarelnaw koe a panue sak.
BAWIPA teh lungmanae hoi pahrennae lah ao.
A lungsaw teh, lungpatawnae hoi a kawi.
Pou na yue mahoeh,
a lung pou khuek mahoeh.
Yon awh e patetlah maimouh koe sak mahoeh.
Payon e patetlah na pathung mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh,
kalvan teh talai hlak a rasang e patetlah,
ama kataketnaw koe vah a lungmanae teh a len.
Kanîtho hoi kanîloum a kâhla e patetlah,
kâtapoenae teh maimouh koehoi
ahla poungnae koe na ta pouh awh.
Na pa ni canaw a lungma e patetlah,
BAWIPA ni ama kataketnaw hah a lungma.
Bangkongtetpawiteh,
maimae tak heh a panue teh
vaiphu lah o awh e hah pahnim hoeh.
Tami e ahninnaw teh pho kahring patetlah ao teh
kahrawng e a pei patetlah doeh ao.
Bangtelah tetpawiteh, kahlî ni a palek teh a pei a kahma,
a onae hmuen hai panuek hoeh toe.
Hatei, BAWIPA lungmanae teh
a ma taketnaw lathueng vah,
a yungyoe hoi a yungyoe totouh a kangning.
A lawkkam tarawi kangainaw hoi
kâpoelawk kapâkuemnaw teh,
a lannae hoi catounnaw totouh a kangning han.
BAWIPA ni kalvan vah
a bawitungkhung a caksak teh,
a uknaeram ni bangpuengpa koung a uk.
Kalvantaminaw BAWIPA teh pholen awh.
A lawk ka ngai ni teh katarawinaw hoi
acawilah thaonae hoi pathoup e lah na o awh.
Nangmouh ransahu pueng,
a thaw katawkkungnaw hoi,
a ngainae kasaknaw BAWIPA teh pholen awh,
A sak e hno pueng kecu dawk,
a uknaeram pueng thungvah,
BAWIPA teh pholen awh.
Oe ka hringnae BAWIPA teh pholen haw.
